title: OpenSculptBoy outfit file (opensculptboy.outfit/1)
description: An outfit apart from any card (docs/wearables.md, 'Outfit files'): its pieces as wearable packages with paths relative to this file, the hides rules and the spring settings of its pieces. 'opensculptboy wearables add CARD FILE.outfit.json' puts it on a card.

provenance.description: private when a piece is private; a private outfit file never goes into a checkout of the repository

file.description: the package's .wearable.json file, relative to this file

overrides.description: fields of the package that this outfit sets for the piece

hides.description: rules added to the packages' own: while 'piece' shows, the named groups of 'target' are hidden

target.description: a piece of this outfit by its id, or a piece of a card as OUTFIT/PIECE or a loose id

springs.description: the spring chains of a piece by its id, in the form of the package's 'springs' field; they replace the package's own

credits.description: the credit lines of the pieces, as the exports write them
